import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0FiniteStageTransitionModels
set_option autoImplicit false
universe u
open CategoryTheory Limits TopologicalSpace TensorProduct
open scoped TensorProduct
namespace AlgebraicGeometry
noncomputable section
@[reducible] noncomputable def pushoutAlgebraOfMap {R A B : Type u}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Algebra R A] [Algebra R B]
    (f : A →ₐ[R] B) : Algebra A B := f.toRingHom.toAlgebra
@[reducible] noncomputable def pushoutTowerOfMap {R A B : Type u}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Algebra R A] [Algebra R B]
    (f : A →ₐ[R] B) :
    letI : Algebra A B := pushoutAlgebraOfMap f
    IsScalarTower R A B := by
  letI : Algebra A B := pushoutAlgebraOfMap f
  exact IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq (fun r => (f.commutes r).symm)
noncomputable def PushoutRing {R A B₁ B₂ : Type u}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [CommRing B₁] [CommRing B₂]
    [Algebra R A] [Algebra R B₁] [Algebra R B₂]
    (f₁ : A →ₐ[R] B₁) (f₂ : A →ₐ[R] B₂) : Type u := by
  letI := pushoutAlgebraOfMap f₁
  letI := pushoutAlgebraOfMap f₂
  exact B₁ ⊗[A] B₂
noncomputable instance {R A B₁ B₂ : Type u}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [CommRing B₁] [CommRing B₂]
    [Algebra R A] [Algebra R B₁] [Algebra R B₂]

  infer_instance

    [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [CommRing B₁] [CommRing B₂]
    [Algebra R A] [Algebra R B₁] [Algebra R B₂]
    (f₁ : A →ₐ[R] B₁) (f₂ : A →ₐ[R] B₂) :
    Algebra R (PushoutRing f₁ f₂) := by
  dsimp only [PushoutRing]
  letI := pushoutAlgebraOfMap f₁
  letI := pushoutAlgebraOfMap f₂
  letI := pushoutTowerOfMap f₁
  exact Algebra.TensorProduct.leftAlgebra
noncomputable def pushoutBC {R K A B₁ B₂ : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing K]
    [CommRing A] [CommRing B₁] [CommRing B₂]
    [Algebra R K] [Algebra R A] [Algebra R B₁] [Algebra R B₂]

    letI : Algebra A B₂ := pushoutAlgebraOfMap f₂
    letI : IsScalarTower R A B₁ := pushoutTowerOfMap f₁
    letI : IsScalarTower R A B₂ := pushoutTowerOfMap f₂
    let g₁ := AlgebraicJacobian.scalarExtensionMap (M := R) (K := K) (A := A) (B := B₁)
    let g₂ := AlgebraicJacobian.scalarExtensionMap (M := R) (K := K) (A := A) (B := B₂)
    letI : Algebra (K ⊗[R] A) (K ⊗[R] B₁) := g₁.toRingHom.toAlgebra
    letI : Algebra (K ⊗[R] A) (K ⊗[R] B₂) := g₂.toRingHom.toAlgebra

  letI : Algebra A B₁ := pushoutAlgebraOfMap f₁

variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] [IsSepClosed k]
abbrev CM {F : Type u} [Field F] [Algebra F k]
    (L : DatG0.FinSubext F k) (n m : Pic0FiniteStageRingIndex C → ℕ)
    (r : ∀ j, Fin (m j) → MvPolynomial (Fin (n j)) L.1)
    (M : DatG0.FinSubext L.1 k) (U : Pic0FiniteStageChartIndex C) :=
  Pic0FiniteStageModelRing C L n m r M (Sum.inl U)

    (L : DatG0.FinSubext F k) (n m : Pic0FiniteStageRingIndex C → ℕ)
    (r : ∀ j, Fin (m j) → MvPolynomial (Fin (n j)) L.1)
    (M : DatG0.FinSubext L.1 k) (U V : Pic0FiniteStageChartIndex C) :=

    (L : DatG0.FinSubext F k) (n m : Pic0FiniteStageRingIndex C → ℕ)
    (r : ∀ j, Fin (m j) → MvPolynomial (Fin (n j)) L.1)
    (M : DatG0.FinSubext L.1 k)
    (mapM : ∀ q : Pic0FiniteStageMapIndex C,
      Pic0FiniteStageModelRing C L n m r M (Pic0FiniteStageMapSource C q) →ₐ[M.1]

    (U V : Pic0FiniteStageChartIndex C) : CM C L n m r M U →ₐ[M.1] OM C L n m r M U V :=

    (L : DatG0.FinSubext F k) (n m : Pic0FiniteStageRingIndex C → ℕ)
    (r : ∀ j, Fin (m j) → MvPolynomial (Fin (n j)) L.1)
    (M : DatG0.FinSubext L.1 k)
    (mapM : ∀ q : Pic0FiniteStageMapIndex C,
      Pic0FiniteStageModelRing C L n m r M (Pic0FiniteStageMapSource C q) →ₐ[M.1]
      Pic0FiniteStageModelRing C L n m r M (Pic0FiniteStageMapTarget C q))
    (U V W : Pic0FiniteStageChartIndex C) :=
  PushoutRing (leftM C L n m r M mapM U V) (leftM C L n m r M mapM U W)

set_option maxHeartbeats 1600000 in
noncomputable def picBC {F : Type u} [Field F] [Algebra F k]
    (L : DatG0.FinSubext F k) (n m : Pic0FiniteStageRingIndex C → ℕ)
    (r : ∀ j, Fin (m j) → MvPolynomial (Fin (n j)) L.1)
    (M : DatG0.FinSubext L.1 k)
    (mapM : ∀ q : Pic0FiniteStageMapIndex C,
      Pic0FiniteStageModelRing C L n m r M (Pic0FiniteStageMapSource C q) →ₐ[M.1]
      Pic0FiniteStageModelRing C L n m r M (Pic0FiniteStageMapTarget C q))
    (U V W : Pic0FiniteStageChartIndex C) :=
  pushoutBC (K := k) (leftM C L n m r M mapM U V) (leftM C L n m r M mapM U W)
#check picBC
#check TM
end
end AlgebraicGeometry`;

# Finite type for relative tensor products

A relative tensor product of two finite-type algebras is finite type over the ground ring,
provided the displayed algebra structures form scalar towers.  The proof presents it as a
quotient of the absolute tensor product over the ground ring.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

open scoped TensorProduct

universe u

namespace AlgebraicJacobian

/-- If `B` and `C` are finite type over `M`, then `B ⊗[A] C` is finite type over `M`.
The `A`-algebra structures need only be compatible with the given `M`-algebra structures. -/
theorem finiteType_tensorProduct_over
    {M A B C : Type u}
    [CommRing M] [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [CommRing C]
    [Algebra M A] [Algebra A B] [Algebra A C]
    [Algebra M B] [Algebra M C]
    [IsScalarTower M A B] [IsScalarTower M A C]
    [Algebra.FiniteType M B] [Algebra.FiniteType M C] :
    Algebra.FiniteType M (B ⊗[A] C) := by
  let f : (B ⊗[M] C) →ₐ[M] (B ⊗[A] C) :=
    Algebra.TensorProduct.lift (R := M) (S := M) (A := B) (B := C)
      ((Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft
        (R := A) (S := A) (A := B) (B := C)).restrictScalars M)
      ((Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight
        (R := A) (A := B) (B := C)).restrictScalars M)
      (fun _ _ => Commute.all _ _)
  have hf : Function.Surjective f := by
    intro z
    induction z using TensorProduct.induction_on with
    | zero => exact ⟨0, map_zero f⟩
    | tmul b c =>
        refine ⟨b ⊗ₜ[M] c, ?_⟩
        simp [f]
    | add x y hx hy =>
        obtain ⟨x', rfl⟩ := hx
        obtain ⟨y', rfl⟩ := hy
        exact ⟨x' + y', map_add f x' y'⟩
  letI : Algebra.FiniteType B (B ⊗[M] C) := Algebra.FiniteType.baseChange B
  letI : IsScalarTower M B (B ⊗[M] C) := by infer_instance
  have hdom : Algebra.FiniteType M (B ⊗[M] C) :=
    Algebra.FiniteType.trans (R := M) (S := B)
      (inferInstance : Algebra.FiniteType M B)
      (inferInstance : Algebra.FiniteType B (B ⊗[M] C))
  exact @Algebra.FiniteType.of_surjective M (B ⊗[M] C) (B ⊗[A] C)
    _ _ _ _ _ hdom f hf

end AlgebraicJacobian
